about: The secreta of the formulary “Vigil of the Nativity of the Lord” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant us, we beseech Thee, almighty God, that as we anticipate the adorable birth of Thy Son, so may we joyfully receive His everlasting gifts, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God,
